name: Non-Uniform Scaling of SDFs
aliases: Non-Uniform Scaling of Signed Distance Functions
definition: A technique to scale an SDF non-uniformly by dividing the sample point by a vector of scaling factors and multiplying the result by the minimum of those factors. This ensures the distance is never overestimated, preventing ray marching failure, though it may underestimate the true distance.
summary: Non-uniform scaling of SDFs transforms primitives by scaling axes differently and multiplying the local distance by the minimum scaling factor to ensure safe distance underestimation for ray marching.
